question: D: Please tell us about the initial concept for Luffy and the others, like Morgan in Volume 1 of “The Birth of the Characters.”
answer: And so on; we received many other proposals like this. Thank you all very much. We plan to proceed gradually from here on out. For now, we're seeking illustrations for a new corner called “Usopp Gallery Pirates”, which will be managed by the illustrator Usopp. Now, a word from the organizer. Usopp: "Ah, this time we're looking for illustrations. But it will be on a small scale. Oda said that if there are too many, it will be difficult to select. Only those who are motivated should submit. The grand prize is a trip around the world. No, I'm kidding! I'll send you an autographed copy of Oda's work! It's a fashion show and illustration of the One Piece character of your choice. The address is at the end of the volume."
